title: Information Set
body_html:
Information Set

For player $i$, information is represented by a partition $$ \{P^i_k\}_{k\in K_i} $$ of player $i$'s decision nodes. A part $P^i_k$ is an information set. Nodes in the same information set cannot be distinguished by player $i$ and must have the same available physical actions.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 6.3.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. Information of player i is a partition of that player's decision nodes.
